reviews.title: Very fast and luxurious ram!!
reviews.comment: Awesome ram kit! Works like a charm, AMD Expo works fine and is really stable at 6000Mts without touching anything else in the bios. I tried running 2 kits of 2 so it had 4 of these in total but no matter what timings and overclocking I used, it overwhelmed the memory controller so I would stick to a regular kit of 2 if you want expo to work as advertised. Otherwise, beautiful and luxurious ram while still serving quality speeds!
reviews.author: Keven

reviews.title: High Performance RAM with Premium Look
reviews.comment: This RAM is both fast and beautiful. 64GB gives me plenty of headroom for multitasking and heavy workloads, and the EXPO profile made setup quick and easy. Performance is stable at 6000MT/s CL30, which is a sweet spot for AMD systems. The design is also very premium and adds a nice visual touch to the build. If you want reliable, high-speed DDR5 with great aesthetics, this is an excellent choice. LED's are plenty bright
reviews.author: Nelly

reviews.title: The best looking RAM kit that's premium in performance.
reviews.comment: Ok, this ram is not cheap, but this is lux.  It is just unique out there.  Both sticks worked perfectly no issues, it comes with a polishing cloth for fingerprints. If you don't remove the plastic film until after you install it You can avoid fingerprints altogether I just pointed off after it's inserted. But yes you will pay a premium, but if you're going to spend that much money on a fish tank case to look at your motherboard, I say go big or go home.  The diamond cut housing for the RGB just adds that extra little flare.  So yes these are aesthetically pleasing.
